description: This is a PHP source file defining the class `Image_Canvas_GD` for handling image rendering using PHP's GD library. It includes methods for creating and manipulating images, drawing shapes, text, and overlays, as well as handling image output in various formats and configurations.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_GD
classes.description: A class for creating and manipulating images using PHP's GD library, supporting various shapes, text, overlays, and image output options.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_GD
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GD image resource based on parameters, choosing between existing GD resource, filename, or creating a new image. Also detects GD version and sets antialiasing options.

methods.name: _getGD
methods.description: Private method to create a GD image resource from a file, supporting PNG, JPEG, and GIF formats.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Private method to get the color index for a specified RGB color or transparency.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Private method to determine and return a GD-compatible line style based on current settings.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Private method to determine and return a GD-compatible fill style, including handling tiled fills and gradients.

methods.name: setFillImage
methods.description: Sets an image to be used for filling shapes.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets font options for text rendering, supporting TTF files and font sizes.

methods.name: _linePixels
methods.description: Helper function to calculate all pixel points along a line between two points for antialiasing.

methods.name: _antialiasedLine
methods.description: Private method for drawing an antialiased line between two points.

methods.name: _antialiasedPixel
methods.description: Helper for drawing a pixel with antialiasing, blending colors based on weights.

methods.name: drawEnd
methods.description: Draws various end caps on lines, such as circles, diamonds, arrows, and boxes.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a simple or antialiased line between two points.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws polygons with options for filling, stroking, and antialiasing, supporting Bezier curves.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws filled or outlined rectangles.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws filled or outlined ellipses.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a filled or outlined pie slice with optional inner radii for doughnut shapes.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width in pixels of a given text string.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height in pixels of a given text string.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Draws text onto the image with alignment, font, and color options.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays another image onto the canvas with alignment and optional resizing.

methods.name: setClipping
methods.description: Defines a clipping region for subsequent drawing operations, or restores previous clipping.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML tag with parameters to display the canvas image in a webpage.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets attributes like line thickness, fill patterns, and font to their defaults.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Detects and returns the installed GD library version (0, 1, or 2).
